---
title: "Comparisons of Independent Groups"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(mu_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(mu_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))

task <- "tgroups1"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

interval <- function(l, u) {
  sprintf("$(%s, %s)$", round(l, 1), round(u, 1))
}

hook(interval(.Lower, .Upper), c(.Lower, .Upper))

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:50, 1)
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-10:10, 1)

  mu_A <- round(runif(1, 25, 45), 1)
  mu_B <- round(runif(1, 20, 40), 1)

  s_A <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)

  if(n_A == n_B)
    next

  s2_pool <- ((n_A - 1) * s_A^2 + (n_B - 1) * s_B^2) / (n_A + n_B - 2)

  tratio <- (mu_A - mu_B) / sqrt(s2_pool * (1/n_A + 1/n_B))

  if(abs(tratio) < 0.5 || abs(tratio) > 1.5)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(tgroups1, tgroups(n_A, mu_A, n_B, mu_B, s2_pool), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options = list(preproc = as.rolog), env = environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(
  "Therapy A" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_A), sprintf("%.2f", mu_A)), 
  "Therapy B" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_B), sprintf("%.2f", mu_B)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

row.names(tab) <- c("Sample size", "Mean symptom score on CAPS-5")


t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```


Question
========
In a clinical trial, patients diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) 
were randomly assigned to Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (Therapy A) or Cognitive Behavioral Therapy 
combined with weekly Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) sessions (Therapy B). 
PTSD symptom severity was assessed after treatment on the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5 (CAPS-5), 
with higher scores indicating more severe symptoms. Consider the following data:

````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align=c("c", "c", "l"))
````

The pooled sample variance is $s^2_{pool}$ = `r round(s2_pool, 2)`.
Assuming equal population variances, 
calculate the $t$-statistic for the difference between Therapy A and Therapy B.


```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $t$-statistic is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
